description.narrative: Country portfolio budget - CPB Ethiopia 2020-2025 Provide nutrition-sensitive social protection, climate risk management services and capacity strengthening support for smallholder farmers, market actors, pastoralists, refugees and returnees most vulnerable to climate shocks.

sector.narrative: By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round
